de: Pope Leo X excommunicates Martin Luther in the papal bull Decet Romanum Pontificem.

te: The Diet of Worms begins, lasting until May 25.
dz: 蠕虫的饮食开始,持续到5月25日.

de: Spanish conquistador Juan Ponce de León sets out from San Juan, Puerto Rico, for Florida with about 200 prospective colonists.

de: Ferdinand Magellan and fifty of his men came ashore to present-day Limasawa to participate in the first Catholic mass in the Philippines.

t: 费迪南德·麦哲伦抵达宿务。
dz: 费迪南德·麦哲伦抵达宿务。

t: 沃尔姆斯议会会议期间开始对马丁·路德的教义进行审判。起初他感到害怕，要求在回答之前给他一些时间…

dz: 沃尔姆斯议会会议期间开始对马丁·路德的教义进行审判。起初他感到害怕，要求在回答之前给他一些时间思考，并得到了一天的停留时间。
de: Trial of Martin Luther over his teachings begins during the assembly of the Diet of Worms. Initially intimidated, he asks for time to reflect before answering and is given a stay of one day.

t: 对马丁·路德的审判在沃尔姆斯议会会议期间开始第二天。尽管面临被逐出教会的风险，他仍拒绝放弃自己…
te: Trial of Martin Luther begins its second day during the assembly of the Diet of Worms. He refuses to recant his teachin…
dz: 对马丁·路德的审判在沃尔姆斯议会会议期间开始第二天。尽管面临被逐出教会的风险，他仍拒绝放弃自己的教义。
de: Trial of Martin Luther begins its second day during the assembly of the Diet of Worms. He refuses to recant his teachings despite the risk of excommunication.

t: 西班牙国王查理一世击败了公社.
te: King Charles I of Spain defeats the Comuneros.
dz: 比利亚拉尔战役:西班牙国王查理一世击败了公社.
de: Battle of Villalar: King Charles I of Spain defeats the Comuneros.

te: Explorer Ferdinand Magellan is killed by natives in the Philippines led by chief Lapulapu.
dz: 麦克坦之战:探索者斐迪南·麦哲伦被酋长拉普拉普所率领的菲律宾原住民所杀.
de: Battle of Mactan: Explorer Ferdinand Magellan is killed by natives in the Philippines led by chief Lapulapu.

de: Swedish War of Liberation: Swedish troops defeat a Danish force in the Battle of Västerås.

t: 第3任白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德被以叛国罪处死.
te: Edward Stafford, 3rd Duke of Buckingham, is executed for treason.
dz: 第3任白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德被以叛国罪处死.

de: Ignatius of Loyola is seriously wounded in the Battle of Pampeluna.

te: The Diet of Worms ends when Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, issues the Edict of Worms, declaring Martin Luther an outlaw.

de: Spanish forces defeat a combined French and Navarrese army at the Battle of Noáin during the Spanish conquest of Iberian Navarre.

t: 经过长时间的围攻后,由西班牙征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯所率领的部队攻克了特拉托阿尼·克瓦特莫克并征…
te: After an extended siege, forces led by Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés capture Tlatoani Cuauhtémoc and conquer the A…

de: After an extended siege, forces led by Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés capture Tlatoani Cuauhtémoc and conquer the Aztec capital of Tenochtitlan.

dz: 丹麦克里斯蒂安二世被废黜瑞典国王，古斯塔夫·瓦萨当选摄政王。
